name: DevilTouch
notes: No build needed: the published app contains no game data and the player adds their own files in the app. Listed while the Public Repo Audit Tracker row allows its existing public release.

steps: Download the DevilTouch IPA from https://github.com/chrissotraidis/deviltouch/releases and check it against the SHA-256 file beside it.
Install it with AltStore Classic, SideStore or Sideloadly, signed with your own Apple ID.
Open DevilTouch. When it asks for your game, pick DIABDAT.MPQ (or spawn.mpq) from your own copy of Diablo, plus the Hellfire .mpq files if you own them.
